findings.evidence: All 505 rows in pipeline_output.csv for rses_total are exactly 5 points higher than the correct score calculated using 3 - v. E.g., R0001 has a correct total of 16.0 and a pipeline total of 21.0.
findings.description: The pipeline uses the incorrect reverse-coding formula for the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES). Per the scoring guide, negatively worded items (3, 5, 8, 9, 10) must be reverse-scored as 3 - v (where v is the stored answer 0-3). The pipeline instead uses 4 - v (resulting in a +1 error per reversed item, adding a total of +5 to every score).
